title: Material Management
subAgency: Dept of the Navy (Military Sealift Command)
description: Military Sealift Command sources sought for non-personal logistics services at MSC ashore locations worldwide: material receipt, stowage, special-material stowage, transportation, disposal, centrally managed stock, inventory audits, and warehouse equipment. Requires a SECRET facility clearance, 98% inventory accuracy, handling of hazardous material and small arms, ship decommissioning support, and 24/7 surge capability. One base year plus four option years starting 19 September 2027. No set-aside used.
